reviews.title: Changed Business
reviews.text: You were able to use it for free but now they’re charging users. Bad for business.

reviews.title: Not a fan since they totally redid the UI
reviews.text: New user interface sucks. Was much simpler (and better) before (when I didn’t have to press 3 buttons to edit the card). It’s too dang confusing now. With all the new options, they’ve complicated everything. I might look for a new flash card app. I hate the new layout.

reviews.title: New completion UI is bad
reviews.text: It no longer shows the change in grade. Also it keeps telling me I'm only 40% to my target even though I haven't set one.

reviews.title: card orientation
reviews.text:
why i cant change “card orientation” setting in new imported deck??!!????
if u answer me, i will change my rating to 5 stars

reviews.title: Doesn’t work as promised
reviews.text: Creating decks using their published documentation is a nightmare and don’t work. I tried every AI to generate language decks but app doesn’t import them. I manually check everything and decks follow their described format precisely, still app don’t see cards when importing

reviews.title: Service keeps getting worse with each update.
reviews.text: The maximum daily reviews for non-paying customers is being lowered with every single update. Today I did my review as normal and was stopped after 80 cards even though the daily limit was 100 cards before. Before it was 100 cards, I never even hit a limit. If you want people to pay to use your service, make it a paid service from the start.

reviews.title: Not Happy with New Update
reviews.text: When I first started using your app a couple of years ago, I was very satisfied. But I noticed that every time you update it and make changes you create problems that were not there before. Currently I cannot edit my content if it extends more than a few lines because I cannot advance the screen upward to access it. Furthermore, it is no longer allowing me to copy and paste content. It allows me to paste it, but not save it. It just disappears. I have to type everything by hand. Please correct. Thanks!

reviews.title: Upper case
reviews.text: Shame this app only supports lower case Cyrillic rather than the every day upper case Cyrillic for Bulgarian.

reviews.title: Reduced number of reviews on free version…
reviews.text: They recently changed from 100 daily to only 80 daily… such a shame, and the algorithm has gotten a lot worse too (keep getting recommend the same cards, never shows older cards so you easily forget them over time)

reviews.title: App won't open on Mac
reviews.text: Don't know how else to report an issue. I click on the app and a white window flashes onto the screen for a second and disappears. Doesn't open at all

reviews.title: Slow and burdensome app
reviews.text: This app starts out free, but once you have added a fair amount of cards you get hit for a $30 in-app purchase. Additionally, as you do more reviews, the app gets slower and slower, as it loads through all the data. Theoretically, this makes sense but it is kind of pathetic as a flashcard specific app. Would not recommend.

reviews.title: Terrible customer support
reviews.text: I’m a premium user, my app has been crashing for well over two weeks now and their customer support service isn’t getting back to me. Still waiting

reviews.title: issues syncing
reviews.text: syncing between apps has so many issues my tags don’t load properly and stay untagged it’s really annoying

reviews.title: Useless ….
reviews.text: Useless app with a lot of bugs

reviews.title: What have they done to this app
reviews.text: Used to be a decent free alternative to anki, but with the new cap, it’s absolutely USELESS… Money hungry devs doing anything to get people to subscribe to premium.

reviews.title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE! Cannot cancel subscription!!
reviews.text: They are lying about being able to cancel auto-renew in account settings! Told them to cancel per their instructions, never got a response and they charged my card anyway. The contact information given is fake and there is no help on their support page. Don’t get ripped off like I did!

reviews.title: Usage
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for six months or more and I would like to summarise my experience and share my impressions. Unfortunately, there’s not much good to say about this app especially for USMLE ( STEPs) studying. I don’t recommend using subscription. Test this app first and you’ll understand. A lot of bugs, no useful updates (last month no updates at all),support doesn’t respond or do nothing, promising fix everything when you text they. Too poor and expensive study app!

reviews.title: Changes to the app make it useless
reviews.text: They’ve changed the free version of the app to only 100 flash card reviews per day total. This is ridiculous for anyone with a decently large deck, especially when you consider the fact it was previously uncapped. Moreover, there is no way to export the flash cards you create into an actually useful file format, suggesting that they simply want you to stay, condede and pay, something made clear by the fact that you can import files from a wide range of useful formats. This app has essentially became bricked and I will now be doing everything in my power to move away, even if it means copy and pasting 1 flash card at a time.

reviews.title: Poorly structured & buggy
reviews.text: App crashed every time I went to Review. Difficult to find anything. Would not recommend

reviews.title: Money taken and account inaccessible
reviews.text: I was logged out of my account and tried logging in as normal, but they require you to enter a code that they never send to your email so I'm forever logged out after paying for a year subscription. Contacted support many times and nothing.

reviews.title: Is this a scam?
reviews.text: I couldn’t get past the “send code” prompt. I sent my email multiple times and never received the code. I deleted the app. #Suspicious #Beware
